text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Ramonu. ...May I pray 
that this year brings you an abundance of 
happiness?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
My, what commonplace words you have for me 
this year.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Every year, I agonize over how to tell 
you, and in the end, I try to gloss over 
it with fancy words. I really need to 
reflect on that bad habit of mine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's why this year, I gave you my 
congratulations straight from the heart. 
...Did it fall short?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —It brings back old memories, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...The crescent moon of days gone by, 
crowned with flowers. And the innocent 
radiance slumbering within it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Yet that faint shimmer never quite 
reaches, failing to illuminate the abyss 
of the peaks looming in the night."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Illuminating and exposing is hardly the 
role of the moon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I know my place. Hence, the moon descends 
to embrace the earth, choosing to support 
the lofty peaks, and everything else.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So once again, under the broad daylight, I 
want to convey my heartfelt blessings 
straight to you. ...Happy birthday, 
Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. No matter how tactful you try to 
be, that inner spark of yours never 
changes."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you, Rudolf. I gladly accept your 
blessings.
